entry_contract.identity_rule: family_key must be minted by a census; historical entries may be not currently observed, while sample, layer, path and hash literals remain evidence only
entry_contract.sentinel_contract: targeted_samples plus regression_gates are mandatory rerun sentinels for future changes to the family or its visible render chain

families.root_cause: The shared sampler schema recognized only framebuffer and previous as graph-input material aliases, so the official historical ui_editor_properties_framebuffer token on hidden g_Texture0 was treated as an unresolved texture binding before Program execution.
families.public_fix: Preserve the authored hidden flag and map only the exact historical token on regular hidden g_Texture0 slot 0 to the current effect graph input, reusing the existing typed graph identity, publication, Program, GraphExecutor and compositor path.

remaining_boundaries: The related 1636394814 mixed chain was rerun and no longer logged this texture-binding alias failure, but it remains NON-PASS at later dependency-owner and material-template-unsupported gates.
Other ui_editor_properties_* keys, non-slot-0 samplers, non-regular modes, label-only metadata and non-hidden declarations remain rejected.
The targeted run proves the visible MyWallpaperX chain, not Wallpaper Engine pixel or timing equivalence.

events.notes: The Water Waves stage and its three following Shake stages all used the same exact historical alias and completed GPU publication, terminal composition and next-frame execution.
